name: Megami Ryoujoku ~Paizuri Hime Verdandi~
original_name: 女神凌辱 ～パイズリ姫ベルダンディー～
source:
Verdandi is a princess of Valhalla. She is beautiful and lives a peaceful life. But one day, her country is invaded by monsters and Verdandi is kept hostage by them. The boss of the monsters, Roki, says to her, "If you give your body to me, we won't kill any more people." She doesn't understand what he means. He also says, "You just give me a blowjob...."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090201043638/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011973]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
贝露丹蒂是英灵殿的公主。她容貌美丽，过着平静的生活。然而一天，国家遭魔物入侵，她也被抓做人质。魔物首领洛基对她说：“只要把身体交给我，我们就不再杀人。”她不明白这句话的含义。洛基又说：“你只要给我口交……”
